Louvre courtyard with the glass pyramid amid historic facades, late-day sun, cobblestone paving; visible tourists throughout bottom third and distant queues. Foreground distinct groups at x=80-160,y=740-845; x=250-280,y=740-838; x=429-570,y=728-852; x=684-720,y=743-832; x=820-870,y=730-843; x=1202-1352,y=727-890. Remove people and their associated cast shadows while retaining architecture, pyramid, equestrian statue, barriers, fixed objects, paving perspective and ambient building shadows.
